accepted.name: prod_reference_author_list
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "RefNo" AS refno,
  "TitleShort" AS title_short,
  "TitleLong" AS title_long,
  "Journal" AS journal,
  "Year" AS year,
  "Pubmed" AS pubmed,
  AUTHORREFERENCE."Name" AS author_name,
  AUTHORREFERENCE."NameOrder" AS author_order
FROM TCGA_MITELMAN.PROD.REFERENCE
JOIN TCGA_MITELMAN.PROD.AUTHORREFERENCE
  ON TCGA_MITELMAN.PROD.REFERENCE."RefNo" = AUTHORREFERENCE."Refno"
accepted.description: One row per author-reference pairing: denormalized relation joining references to their authors. Useful when you need reference metadata with author names and ordering for citation-level reporting or to filter references by author. | Use for: List references with their authors and ordering; Filter references by author name or by year; Produce citation strings grouped by reference

accepted.name: prod_case_investigations
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  CYTOGENINV."RefNo" AS refno,
  CYTOGENINV."CaseNo" AS caseno,
  CYTOGENINV."InvNo" AS invno,
  CYTOGEN."Sex" AS sex,
  CYTOGEN."Age" AS age,
  CYTOGEN."Race" AS race,
  CYTOGEN."Country" AS country,
  CYTOGENINV."InvDate" AS inv_date,
  CYTOGENINV."Tissue" AS tissue,
  CYTOGENINV."Clones" AS clones,
  CYTOGENINV."KaryLength" AS kary_length,
  CYTOGENINV."KaryShort" AS kary_short,
  CYTOGENINV."KaryLong" AS kary_long,
  CYTOGENINV."CaseOrder" AS case_order
FROM TCGA_MITELMAN.PROD.CYTOGENINV
LEFT JOIN TCGA_MITELMAN.PROD.CYTOGEN
  ON CYTOGENINV."RefNo" = CYTOGEN."RefNo"
  AND CYTOGENINV."CaseNo" = CYTOGEN."CaseNo"
accepted.description: One row per cytogenetic investigation combining case-level metadata (CYTOGEN) with investigation record (CYTOGENINV). Keeps reference and case identifiers for joins. Use for analyses that need case demographics alongside investigation attributes. | Use for: Aggregate investigation counts by country/sex/age; Filter investigations by tissue or karyotype length; Join to clone/abnormality details for per-investigation summaries

accepted.name: prod_karyclone_with_bits_breaks_abnorm
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  KARYCLONE."RefNo" AS refno,
  KARYCLONE."CaseNo" AS caseno,
  KARYCLONE."InvNo" AS invno,
  KARYCLONE."CloneNo" AS cloneno,
  KARYCLONE."ChromoMin" AS chromo_min,
  KARYCLONE."ChromoMax" AS chromo_max,
  KARYCLONE."CloneShort" AS clone_short,
  KARYCLONE."CloneLong" AS clone_long,
  KARYCLONE."CloneLength" AS clone_length,
  KARYCLONE."Sole" AS sole,
  COUNT(DISTINCT KARYBIT."OrderNo") AS bits_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT KARYBREAK."OrderNo") AS breaks_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT KARYABNORM."OrderNo") AS abnorm_count
FROM TCGA_MITELMAN.PROD.KARYCLONE
LEFT JOIN TCGA_MITELMAN.PROD.KARYBIT
  ON KARYCLONE."RefNo" = KARYBIT."RefNo"
  AND KARYCLONE."CaseNo" = KARYBIT."CaseNo"
  AND KARYCLONE."InvNo" = KARYBIT."InvNo"
  AND KARYCLONE."CloneNo" = KARYBIT."CloneNo"
LEFT JOIN TCGA_MITELMAN.PROD.KARYBREAK
  ON KARYCLONE."RefNo" = KARYBREAK."RefNo"
  AND KARYCLONE."CaseNo" = KARYBREAK."CaseNo"
  AND KARYCLONE."InvNo" = KARYBREAK."InvNo"
  AND KARYCLONE."CloneNo" = KARYBREAK."CloneNo"
LEFT JOIN TCGA_MITELMAN.PROD.KARYABNORM
  ON KARYCLONE."RefNo" = KARYABNORM."RefNo"
  AND KARYCLONE."CaseNo" = KARYABNORM."CaseNo"
  AND KARYCLONE."InvNo" = KARYABNORM."InvNo"
  AND KARYCLONE."CloneNo" = KARYABNORM."CloneNo"
GROUP BY
  KARYCLONE."RefNo",
  KARYCLONE."CaseNo",
  KARYCLONE."InvNo",
  KARYCLONE."CloneNo",
  KARYCLONE."ChromoMin",
  KARYCLONE."ChromoMax",
  KARYCLONE."CloneShort",
  KARYCLONE."CloneLong",
  KARYCLONE."CloneLength",
  KARYCLONE."Sole"
accepted.description: One row per clone (RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, CloneNo) with counts of associated karyotype bits, breaks, and abnormalities. Useful to summarize clone complexity or to filter clones by number of reported features. | Use for: Rank clones by number of abnormalities or breaks; Filter clones with high complexity for downstream manual review; Join clone summaries to CYTOCONVERTED events

accepted.name: prod_cytoconverted_events
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "RefNo" AS refno,
  "CaseNo" AS caseno,
  "InvNo" AS invno,
  "Clone" AS cloneno,
  "Chr" AS chr,
  "ChrOrd" AS chr_ord,
  "Start" AS start_pos,
  "End" AS end_pos,
  "Type" AS type,
  "CellsPresent" AS cells_present
FROM TCGA_MITELMAN.PROD.CYTOCONVERTED
accepted.description: Normalized projection of CYTOCONVERTED events: one row per converted cytogenetic event with canonical column names. Use this when analyzing chromosomal-event level patterns (counts by chromosome, start/end coordinates, event types). | Use for: Count converted events per chromosome or type; Join converted events to cytoband coordinates; Filter events by presence/absence flags

accepted.name: prod_cytoband_map_hg38
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "chromosome" AS chromosome,
  "cytoband_name" AS cytoband_name,
  "hg38_start" AS hg38_start,
  "hg38_stop" AS hg38_stop
FROM TCGA_MITELMAN.PROD.CYTOBANDS_HG38
accepted.description: Normalized cytoband reference table: one row per cytoband with numeric start/stop coordinates (hg38). Useful for mapping cytogenetic calls to genomic bands or for interval-join operations. | Use for: Map events (start/end) to cytobands; Aggregate events by cytoband; Filter cytobands for a chromosome

accepted.name: prod_reference_latest_by_year_rank
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  refno,
  title_short,
  title_long,
  journal,
  year,
  pubmed,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY year DESC, refno ASC) AS year_rank
FROM (
  SELECT
    "RefNo" AS refno,
    "TitleShort" AS title_short,
    "TitleLong" AS title_long,
    "Journal" AS journal,
    "Year" AS year,
    "Pubmed" AS pubmed
  FROM TCGA_MITELMAN.PROD.REFERENCE
) base_refs
accepted.description: Reference-level ranking per year: one row per reference with a year-based rank (newest-first) using Year. Useful to pick top-N newest references per year or to deduplicate when multiple variant records per RefNo exist. | Use for: Select top-N references per year; Find the latest references overall or per-year buckets; Deduplicate references preferring latest/year-sorted order

accepted.name: tcga_clinical_basic_demographics
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "case_id" AS case_id,
  "submitter_id" AS submitter_id,
  "primary_site" AS primary_site,
  "disease_type" AS disease_type,
  "proj__project_id" AS project_id,
  "demo__gender" AS gender,
  "demo__race" AS race,
  "demo__ethnicity" AS ethnicity,
  "demo__age_at_index" AS age_at_index,
  "diag__year_of_diagnosis" AS year_of_diagnosis,
  "diag__primary_diagnosis" AS primary_diagnosis,
  "diag__tumor_stage" AS tumor_stage
FROM TCGA_MITELMAN.TCGA_VERSIONED.CLINICAL_GDC_R24
accepted.description: Cohort-level projection of the clinical GDC R24 table with essential demographic fields. One row per case_id. Use when building cohorts by disease_type, primary_site, gender, race or for joining to sample-level genomics. | Use for: Define clinical cohorts by primary_site/disease_type; Aggregate demographics by project or diagnosis; Join to molecular data via case_id

accepted.name: tcga_methylation_probe_summary
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "probe_id" AS probe_id,
  COUNT(*) AS measurements_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT "case_barcode") AS distinct_case_count,
  AVG("beta_value") AS mean_beta,
  STDDEV_SAMP("beta_value") AS sd_beta
FROM TCGA_MITELMAN.TCGA_VERSIONED.DNA_METHYLATION_CHR19_HG38_GDC_2017_01
GROUP BY "probe_id"
accepted.description: Aggregated probe-level summary for a DNA methylation table: one row per probe_id with count, mean, stddev of beta_value and distinct sample count. Useful for QC, probe filtering, or general methylation summaries. This candidate is generic and can be applied to any of the chromosome-specific methylation tables by swapping the input table. | Use for: Identify probes with high variance or missingness; Filter probes for downstream differential methylation; Per-probe QC and summary statistics

accepted.name: prod_molclin_gene_abnorm
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  MBCA."MolClin" AS molclin,
  MBCA."RefNo" AS refno,
  MBCA."InvNo" AS invno,
  MBCA."Morph" AS morph,
  MBCA."Topo" AS topo,
  MBCA."KaryLength" AS kary_length,
  MBCA."KaryShort" AS kary_short,
  MBCA."KaryLong" AS kary_long,
  ABN."OrderNo" AS abn_order,
  ABN."Abnormality" AS abnormality,
  GENE."OrderNo" AS gene_order,
  GENE."Prefix" AS gene_prefix,
  GENE."Gene" AS gene,
  GENE."Suffix" AS gene_suffix
FROM TCGA_MITELMAN.PROD.MOLBIOLCLINASSOC MBCA
LEFT JOIN TCGA_MITELMAN.PROD.MOLCLINABNORM ABN
  ON MBCA."MolClin" = ABN."MolClin"
  AND MBCA."RefNo" = ABN."RefNo"
  AND MBCA."InvNo" = ABN."InvNo"
LEFT JOIN TCGA_MITELMAN.PROD.MOLCLINGENE GENE
  ON MBCA."MolClin" = GENE."MolClin"
  AND MBCA."RefNo" = GENE."RefNo"
  AND MBCA."InvNo" = GENE."InvNo"
accepted.description: One row per molecular-clinical association abnormality annotated with gene(s) and karyotype summary. Joins MOLCLINABNORM, MOLCLINGENE and MOLBIOLCLINASSOC to provide gene and abnormality context for each mol-clin record. | Use for: List gene abnormalities associated with molecular-clinical annotations; Aggregate abnormality counts by gene or karyotype summary; Filter molecular-clinical records by morphology/topography
